brief: Breakout timing: Now - AI agent frameworks are the hottest trend in open-source.
Single best opportunity: NousResearch/hermes-agent - Extensible AI agent framework for building autonomous task-completing agents.
Other standout opportunities: DietrichGebert/ponytail (Lazy coding assistant), Panniantong/Agent-Reach (CLI internet browsing agent), and Graphify-Labs/graphify (Codebase to knowledge graph).
Potential: High - AI agent frameworks are in high demand across industries.
Action: Start building or integrating an AI agent framework into your product roadmap.

items.why_now: Agent frameworks are exploding with 17.5% weekly star growth; Hermes has momentum as the go-to OSS choice, and enterprises are actively seeking customizable alternatives to closed AI agent products
